info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Management API
info.description: The Webhook Management API facilitates the dynamic creation and configuration of webhook endpoints essential for real-time event notifications and integrations. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline communication between their applications and external services, ensuring timely data exchange and triggering actions based on specific events. Typical consumers include developers and system integrators who require automated workflows and enhanced interoperability between platforms. This API empowers users to efficiently manage webhook subscriptions and configurations to align with evolving business needs.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new webhook. You can set a callback URL that will be invoked when specific events occur. Make sure to configure the necessary event types when creating the webhook.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the necessary information for creating or updating a webhook endpoint. It must adhere to the specified JSON schema to ensure proper processing.

201.description: Resource created successfully and ready for use.

merchantId.description: The unique identifier for the merchant.

url.description: The URL to which the webhook will send its POST requests.

description.description: A brief description of the webhook's purpose.

events.description: A list of events that will trigger the webhook.

items.description: The name of the event to subscribe to.

events.description: A list of events that the webhook will subscribe to.

items.description: The name of an event to be sent via the webhook.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the webhook endpoint.
